title: Mutable draft revisions versus immutable publication
summary: Visual/AI operations advance mutable project revisions and draft snapshots. publish() is the explicit materialisation boundary that creates exact versioned component/element/material/projection/journey/experiment artifacts and SHA-512 seals the release graph.
invariants: Do not manufacture a public artifact version for every mouse move or AI proposal.
Draft operation identity can be fast/deterministic; auditDigest is explicit evidence.
Published release graphs remain cryptographically sealed.
